plugins.name: token-watch
plugins.description: Plan usage and the context window as thin bars above the Claude Code prompt, with a prompt cache countdown and an opt-in keep-warm. Right-click to cycle its views; a settings panel picks what it shows; /context-bar hides it, or reads it as text where nothing draws.
